sentences.text:
OFFICE NO. NOTE  RNT,J  1. 12.02.2024  This Contempt Petition is filed alleging wilful  disobedience of the writ courts order dated  05.05.2023 passed in W.P.No.11853 of 2023.
 2. Para No.11 of the judgment reads as under:-
 "11.

In view of the further stand of the  respondents that they would follow due process of law, this writ petition is being disposed of finally with direction to the respondents to follow the due procedure laid down under the provisions of Sections 146/147 of the Andhra Pradesh Municipal Corporation Act r/w Land Acquisition Act for taking petitioner's site for the master plan road, and by making the payment of compensation provided by Sections 146/147 of the Municipal Corporation Act."
3.

entities.text: Andhra Pradesh Municipal Corporation Act r/w Land Acquisition Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the copy of the order dated 05.05.2023 was served to the respondents and was also displayed at the site of the land.
He submits that the respondents have highhandedly laid the road on 05.10.2023 without following the due procedure of law and without paying any compensation.
4. Issue notice to the respondents to file the response.
